name: North Carolina Senate Page Program
what_you_do: Spend one week working in the state Senate in Raleigh. Pages work on the Senate floor and in committee meetings, deliver messages and papers, and help with office tasks.
who_can_apply: Students in grade 10, 11 or 12 who are in good school standing. A North Carolina senator must sponsor you. If you serve during the school year, your principal must approve it first.
pay_detail: $150 stipend for the week, or 30 hours of community service credit instead. No housing is provided.
duration: One week during the legislative session: report Monday afternoon, work Tuesday to Thursday
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full. Available weeks for the 2027 session will be posted early next year. When it opens, applications are taken on a rolling basis until weeks are full.
how_to_apply: Contact your senator and ask for an application. It is not online and not available from the Page office. Return the finished form to your senator.
notes: Competitive. Each senator can sponsor only a set number of students. The Senate President Pro Tempore makes the appointments. Business clothes are required. Bring money for lunch each day. Paid work for people under 18 in North Carolina needs a Youth Employment Certificate. See permit.html?state=nc for the exact permit and steps.
